candidates.comment: Thanks for the report. Automatic recovery without manually clicking Retry, while keeping the error visible, is tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/288094. This report adds the network-interruption case: agents should recover when connectivity returns rather than require each request to be restarted manually.

Thanks for the report. This repeats https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/346579, including the Windows 1.145.2 startup steps, logs, and Refresh workaround. That thread also has an independent confirmation, so let's consolidate the investigation there.

Thanks for the detailed report. This matches the Windows/remote changed-file path regression tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/346020. Linking your WSL launch steps, confirmation across models, slash mismatch between the list and hover, and subsequent trust warning there so those details remain part of the investigation.

Thanks for the report. This matches the remote changed-file widget problem tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/346023. This report adds an Arch Linux-to-Debian reproduction on 1.145.0 and confirms that creating the same path locally makes the widget open the local copy; those details should be retained in the investigation.
